newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha firms, tighter June market expected.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha firms, tighter June market expected.

text.p: NWE naphtha markets were firmer on Monday in line with crude's strong gains late on Friday and expectations of a tighter June market.
Many European traders were absent from the market because of the Whit Monday holiday, but those who remained bid the market up sharply.
June swaps climbed $4 to trade at $191 a tonne cif NWE.
On the physical market, a trading house was bidding at $186 for pipeline spec material for delivery between May 25 and June 5.
